title: Locked/Blocked Exit
description: Use this service request in any situation where a required exit door, exit window or exit pathway, including stairwells and stairways, are blocked or locked. The estimated response time for this service request is 1 business day.

observedQuestions.question: What is the occupancy location type?
If this is a business, what is the name of the business/facility?
Please explain what is being locked/blocked and its location:
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Occupancy = Storage/warehouse/parking garage; business and exit description supplied; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a required exit door, exit window, or exit pathway that is locked or blocked, including stairwells and stairways.
actions.why: For a required exit door, exit window, or exit pathway that is locked or blocked, including stairwells and stairways. The request form asks for occupancy type and a description and location of the blocked or locked exit.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Locked/Blocked Exit"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Locked/Blocked Exit"
